name: Bowl frame
purpose: Concept of the frame that keeps the bowls in place over one monitor: a flat plate with a hole for each bowl, lying on the acrylic sheet. Not released: the layout, the thickness, the material and how the plate is located on the sheet are to be confirmed.
written_by: studies/bowls/derive.py, from studies/bowls/study.json. Change the study and run it again; do not edit this file.

layout.note: Bowls in columns along the display's width and rows along its height, about the centre of the lit area. A pitch is the distance between two bowls' axes; "auto" spaces the bowls as evenly as the limits allow. The pitches here are worked out by the study where it says "auto".

assumed_mm.note: The plate with a hole for each bowl. Not in the brief.

limits_mm.note: A layout that breaks one of these is refused, with the amount it is short by.
